notes.title: Paperback v2.2.18 - Bug fixes and new game options
notes.content:
Fixed issue where you could trash commons before claiming them
Fixed issue with cards that add to draw when they are the last letter

Added ? symbols to game modes
Added new "3 Pile End" option
Added new "Original Deck" option
Added option to use Typos or not

Fixed issue with trashing cards of no value
Fixed issue where cards could not be bought

notes.title: Paperback v2.2.15
notes.content:
Fixed bug with cards that turn other cards into Wilds not working when scoring a word
Fixed issue where AI would get stuck buying

notes.title: Paperback v2.2.14 Bugs and QoL Update
notes.content:
Solo game settings are saved between games 
Fixed scroll on UI menus not being interactable and more responsive to scrolling
Fixed issue where the log was not populating when returning to a game
Fixed issue where player could interact with the shop during a bots turn
Fixed issue where cards were missing their interaction button when put into play
Fixed issue where cards would not double score of other cards
Fixed issue where the score preview would be wrong for cards that doubled word score
Made it more clear which card is effecting another
Fixed issue where cards would not score if once effected by a double score card
Bots not has correct values for words that had double word score or double score of individual cards
Books don't reset when adding another player or bot in solo
Wild menu can now be canceled when closing window without picking a letter or default to A if a letter is not picked
Most menus can now be close by clicking off of them
Volume sliders and mute button added to settings
Fixed issue where inspecting cards would get stuck
Optimization added to help with devices using too much CPU

notes.title: Minor Update v2.2.13
notes.content:
Added the ability to Exit the Game by clicking the Top Right X
Added the ability to make the game fullscreen or window in the main settings menu
Fixed an issue where the AI would take a really long time to find a word when it has a lot of wilds in its hand
Fixed an issue where players could join games with older versions of the game which then caused a crash

Card Fixes:
Fixed an issue where you could trash fame cards from the store
Fixed an issue where on card abilities dealing with "three consonants in a row" not working properly with wilds

notes.title: Update for version 2.2.12
notes.content:
New cards added to celebrate the tenth anniversary event
Minor bug fixes for online play

notes.title: Update Notes for Aug 11th
notes.content:
Fixes to common win conditions
Fixes to card backgrounds being incorrect

notes.title: Update Notes for Aug 3
notes.content:
Three letter words now swap properly
Scoring 10 letter common card in Coop no longer crashes game
Sped up how long it shows a condition is not being met
Copied multiplier cards not award proper points
Card "A" with the ability to draw if first letter, no longer awards when it is not the first card
Player can no longer target a nonadjacent card when making them into wilds
+1 per vowel in word now considers wilds changed into vowels
Bot targeting cards to triple now doesn't freeze the game

Card Changes:

3 Cent A had wrong effect
6 Cent Wild is suppose to be a W
7 Cent K was missing effect
7 Cent K had wrong condition and effect
7 Cent X missing triple effect
